title: The Door in the Air
text: A door stands in empty space, frame and all, hanging over the dark with no wall to hold it. It is painted green, with a brass knocker. Through the keyhole come warm golden sunlight and the sound of bees.

options.label: Open the green door, and step into the sunlight beyond.

outcomes.text: For one long moment there is real sunlight, warm, and the sound of bees. Then it is gone, though you carry it with you always.
It is not sunlight. Something on the other side was making the sound of bees, and it is very pleased you opened the door.

options.label: The sharpest eye looks through the keyhole, before anyone opens it.

outcomes.text: Through the keyhole lies home, small and bright and far away, along with the way back to it if you are quick.

options.label: Leave it shut. No door hangs in the air for any good reason.

outcomes.text: As you go, someone on the other side knocks politely, three times.
